description: Implementation of polar coding algorithms, including generation of mother codes, interleavers, and code parameter setup for polar codes in a telecommunications context.

classes.name: polar_code_impl
classes.description: Class implementing polar code encoding, decoding, and parameter management.

methods.name: get_mother_code
methods.description: Returns the mother code sequence for a given code length parameter n.

methods.name: get_blk_interleaver
methods.description: Returns the block interleaver sequence for a given code length parameter n.

methods.name: setdiff_stable
methods.description: Computes the set difference between two sequences with stability considerations.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Configures the polar code parameters including K, E, nMax, and ibil.

methods.name: get_n
methods.description: Returns the current value of n (log2 of code length).

methods.name: get_K
methods.description: Returns the number of information bits K.

methods.name: get_E
methods.description: Returns the rate-matched codeword length E.

methods.name: get_nPC
methods.description: Returns the number of parity check bits.

methods.name: get_K_set
methods.description: Returns the set of information bit indices.

methods.name: get_PC_set
methods.description: Returns the set of parity check bit indices.

methods.name: get_blk_interleaver
methods.description: Returns the block interleaver sequence for current n.
